# Projects {.unlisted}

This section contains four substantial projects, two from each section of the course. Between them they cover model comparison (all four), computational programming from first principles (Projects 1, 3 and 4) and real-world data (all four).

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
::: {.grid .project-cards}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
[Project 1 · Section 2 · Exponential smoothing]{.card-kicker}

[Forecasting South African electricity demand](project-01.qmd){.stretched-link .card-link}

Holt-Winters coded from first principles and compared with ETS models and naive benchmarks, forecasting daily Eskom demand 1 to 14 days ahead.

[First principles]{.tag} [Model comparison]{.tag} [Real-world data]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
[Project 2 · Section 1 · Seasonal ARIMA]{.card-kicker}

[Predicting drought in the Western Cape](project-02.qmd){.stretched-link .card-link}

Seasonal ARIMA and dynamic regression: does lagged Pacific sea surface temperature improve forecasts of Theewaterskloof Dam levels?

[Model comparison]{.tag} [Real-world data]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
[Project 3 · Section 1 · ARCH and GARCH]{.card-kicker}

[Predicting JSE volatility](project-03.qmd){.stretched-link .card-link}

ARCH, GARCH and GJR-GARCH compared out of sample on daily All Share Index returns, with the GARCH(1,1) likelihood coded by hand.

[First principles]{.tag} [Model comparison]{.tag} [Real-world data]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
[Project 4 · Section 2 · Hidden Markov models]{.card-kicker}

[Market regimes on the JSE](project-04.qmd){.stretched-link .card-link}

HMM algorithms built from first principles, then used to find market regimes in All Share Index returns and compared with GJR-GARCH.
